title: Limited
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.1-inch touchscreen + 10.25-inch digital instrument cluster + optional 10.25-inch passenger touchscreen.
adasStandard: Active Driving Assist (hands-on lane centering + adaptive cruise), AEB with pedestrian/cyclist detection, blind-spot monitoring + rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning + lane-keep assist, drowsy-driver detection, ParkSense rear park assist, ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic guidelines, 9-speaker stereo, heated front and rear seats, panoramic sunroof. Source: https://www.jeep.com/grand-cherokee-4xe.html
adasOptional: Advanced ProTech Group adds 360-degree surround-view camera, intersection collision assist, night vision, drowsy-driver enhanced, traffic-sign recognition. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines. Source: https://www.jeep.com/grand-cherokee-4xe.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Optional 360-degree surround-view camera in Advanced ProTech Group; not standard on Limited. No side-blind/LaneWatch turn-signal camera; no trailer-specific view. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
subscriptionFeatures: Wi-Fi PLUS ~$19.99/mo. SiriusXM trial then paid. Free2move Charge bundle varies by build. No subscription-locked mechanicals (4xe locks the diff via hardware, not subscription). Source: https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
drmNotes: Same as Wagoneer S — Uconnect 5 core driving and infotainment surface (CarPlay/Android Auto wireless, FM/AM, Bluetooth) function offline; remote app, OTA, SOS, charging remote control, voice assistant require active Connect ONE link (10 years included). Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/, https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
killSwitchNotes: No federal-mandate impaired-driving kill switch. Standard drowsy-driver detection issues warnings only. Active Driving Assist includes a hands-on/driver-attention check via steering-wheel torque sensor and a forward-facing camera; failure to respond results in escalating warnings then a controlled stop, but only while the assistant is engaged. Source: https://www.jeep.com/grand-cherokee-4xe.html
knownIssues: Loss-of-propulsion warnings (shared 4xe powertrain issue), Uconnect glitches, sporadic 12V battery drain, some owners report panoramic sunroof rattles and HV battery cooling pump noise. Source: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/expert-reviews/2025-jeep-wrangler-4xe-review-update
recalls: Inherits 4xe powertrain-platform recalls; 25V-115 (Feb 2025) software calibration for hybrid drive module loss-of-propulsion (OTA remedy). Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Lost federal $7,500 Jan 1 2025; Stellantis offering $7,500 manufacturer rebate on remaining inventory. State PHEV rebates vary. Sources: https://www.carsdirect.com/automotive-news/2025-jeep-plug-in-hybrids-lose-tax-credit, https://electrek.co/2025/10/03/jeep-dodge-chrysler-vehicles-still-qualify-for-7500-ev-credit/

title: Overland
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.1-inch touchscreen + 10.25-inch digital cluster + 10.25-inch passenger screen + heads-up display.
adasStandard: Same as Limited plus 19-speaker McIntosh audio, Nappa leather, heated + ventilated front seats, Quadra-Lift air suspension, 360 camera standard. Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
adasOptional: Advanced ProTech Group available (intersection collision assist, night vision, traffic-sign recognition).
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines.
knownIssues: Same as Limited; some early-build Overland units reported HUD calibration drift addressed via OTA.

title: Summit
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 10.1-inch touchscreen + 10.25-inch digital cluster + 10.25-inch passenger screen + heads-up display + McIntosh 19-speaker audio.
adasStandard: Same as Overland plus 12-way power-adjustable front seats, oak and chrome interior trim, premium leather, ProTech IV bundle (some Advanced ProTech features pulled in as standard). Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
adasOptional: Advanced ProTech Group remaining items still available.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines.

title: Summit Reserve
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with all screens standard (10.1 center + 10.25 cluster + 10.25 passenger), McIntosh 19-speaker audio, heads-up display.
adasStandard: Loaded top trim — Active Driving Assist + full Advanced ProTech Group standard (intersection collision assist, night vision, traffic-sign recognition, drowsy-driver enhanced, surround-view 360). Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines.

title: Trailhawk
adasStandard: Same as Limited plus Quadra-Drive II with Electronic Limited-Slip Rear Differential, Quadra-Lift air suspension, Selec-Speed Control off-road system, skid plates, hill-descent control, factory off-road tires, 360 surround camera standard. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-grand-cherokee-4xe-trims.htm
adasOptional: Advanced ProTech Group (intersection collision assist, night vision, traffic-sign recognition). Source: https://cars.usnews.com/cars-trucks/jeep/grand-cherokee-4xe
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines; integrated with the standard 360 system.
sideViewCameraNotes: 360-degree surround-view camera standard on Trailhawk with off-road forward, side, and rear views. No turn-signal-triggered side blind camera. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-grand-cherokee-4xe-trims.htm
knownIssues: Same as Limited plus owners report air-suspension compressor faults on early WL units.

title: Moab
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 14.5-inch touchscreen + 12.3-inch driver display + 10.25-inch passenger display. Snapdragon-based SoC.
adasStandard: Active Driving Assist (hands-on lane centering + adaptive cruise), AEB with pedestrian/cyclist detection, blind-spot monitoring + rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning + lane-keep assist, drowsy-driver detection, intersection collision assist, traffic-sign recognition, ParkSense park assist with stop, surround-view 360 camera. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/jeep/recon/2026/st-402091444/features-specs/
adasOptional: No higher-tier hands-free ADAS announced. Stellantis Highway Assist hands-free system was previewed at CES but not confirmed for Recon launch. Source: https://carbuzz.com/2026-jeep-recon-specs-pricing/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rearview camera with dynamic guidelines, integrated with the 360 surround system; off-road camera modes also available. Source: https://www.jeep.com/recon.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-View 360 standard with split-screen and dedicated off-road perspective modes (front, side approach, wheel-articulation views). No Honda-LaneWatch-style turn-signal side camera. Source: https://www.jeep.com/recon.html
subscriptionFeatures: Same Stellantis baseline as Wagoneer S — Wi-Fi PLUS ~$19.99/mo, SiriusXM after trial. Launch promo (rumored) includes complimentary Free2move Charge credits and bundled NACS Supercharger access; exact terms not yet published. No subscription-locked mechanicals. Source: https://www.jeep.com/recon.html
drmNotes: Same Stellantis envelope as Wagoneer S — core driving and infotainment offline-capable; remote, OTA, SOS, voice assistant, and charging app control require Connect ONE link. Recon ships with native NACS so Supercharger access does not require an adapter. Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/, https://evdances.com/blogs/news/jeep-and-dodge-evs-to-gain-tesla-supercharger-access-starting-in-2026
killSwitchNotes: No federal-mandate impaired-driving kill switch announced for launch spec. Camera-based driver-attention monitor included with Active Driving Assist. No in-cabin alcohol sensor. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/jeep/recon/2026/features-specs/
knownIssues: Data unavailable: no production units delivered to customers as of 2026-05-21; long-term reliability data does not exist. Pre-production reviews flagged the 230-mile range as low for a $67k BEV.
recalls: Data unavailable: no recalls posted as of 2026-05-21 for the as-yet-unproduced 2026 Recon.
stateIncentives: Federal $7,500 EV credit ended September 2025 — does not apply to Recon at launch. Stellantis manufacturer rebate program for legacy 4xe inventory does not cover Recon. State incentives vary: CO $5,000 state BEV credit available; NY Drive Clean up to $2,000 (MSRP cap permitting); CA CVRP closed. Sources: https://electrek.co/2025/10/03/jeep-dodge-chrysler-vehicles-still-qualify-for-7500-ev-credit/

title: Launch Edition
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 12.3-inch center touchscreen + 12.3-inch driver display + 10.25-inch passenger display (standard on Launch Edition).
adasStandard: Active Driving Assist (hands-on lane-centering + adaptive cruise), AEB with pedestrian detection, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning + lane-keep assist, drowsy-driver detection, full-speed forward collision warning, ParkSense park assist, Intersection Collision Assist System. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.launch-edition.html
adasOptional: Launch Edition was fully loaded; no higher ADAS package available. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/jeep/wagoneer-s/2025/st-402064321/features-specs/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rearview camera with dynamic guidelines, integrated with the 360-deg system. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.launch-edition.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-View Camera 360-degree system standard with split-screen modes. No turn-signal-triggered side camera; no trailer-view camera. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.launch-edition.html
subscriptionFeatures: Launch Edition included 3 years complimentary Free2move Charge DC fast-charge sessions (30 min each), 3-month SiriusXM trial, included Wi-Fi PLUS for an introductory period (terms vary by build month); after expiry, Wi-Fi PLUS continues at $19.99/mo. No subscription-locked performance or comfort features. Sources: https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
drmNotes: Same connectivity envelope as Limited — core driving and CarPlay/Android Auto run fully offline; remote app, OTA, voice assistant, SOS, and stolen-vehicle services require active 'Connect ONE' (included 10 years). Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/, https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
killSwitchNotes: Same as Limited: no federal-mandate impaired-driving kill switch; driver-attention monitor tied to Active Driving Assist; no in-cabin alcohol sensor. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.launch-edition.html
knownIssues: Early launch builds had Uconnect freezes, charge-port firmware bugs, occasional 12V LV battery drain; mostly addressed via OTA. Some owner reports of cabin rattles and uneven panel gaps consistent with first-year production. Source: https://roadtestreviews.com/2025-jeep-wagoneer-s-launch-edition-review-fast-but-flawed/
recalls: Same as Limited — NHTSA 25V-217 propulsion-loss software (OTA), 25V-381 rearview camera image display (OTA). Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Same as Limited: federal $7,500 (or Stellantis manufacturer rebate equivalent post-Sept 2025). State rebates vary; many state caps (e.g., NJ $55k) exclude Launch Edition at $72k. Source: https://electrek.co/2025/10/03/jeep-dodge-chrysler-vehicles-still-qualify-for-7500-ev-credit/

title: Limited
infotainment: Uconnect 5 on a 12.3-inch touchscreen with a 12.3-inch driver display; optional 10.25-inch passenger screen. Snapdragon-based SoC. Hardware buttons for climate retained.
adasStandard: Active Driving Assist (hands-on lane-centering + adaptive cruise), automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, blind-spot monitoring, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-departure warning + lane-keep assist, drowsy driver detection, full-speed forward collision warning, ParkSense parallel/perpendicular park assist. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.limited.html
adasOptional: No higher-tier hands-free ADAS is offered on the Limited; the Launch Edition's package was identical. Stellantis' Highway Assist (hands-free) was demoed at CES 2024 but is not yet shipping on Wagoneer S as of MY2025. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/jeep/wagoneer-s/2025/st-402064321/features-specs/
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rearview camera with dynamic guidelines. Default resolution; not a high-res or multi-angle setup. No advanced perspective options beyond the standard rear view. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.limited.html
sideViewCameraNotes: Surround-View Camera System (360-degree bird's-eye view) is standard on Limited, with split-screen front/rear and side perspectives. No Honda-LaneWatch-style turn-signal-triggered side camera; no integrated trailer-view camera (Wagoneer S is not towing-optimized). Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.limited.html
subscriptionFeatures: Wi-Fi PLUS package: ~$19.99/mo or ~$199/yr for in-vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot (unlimited data, 8 devices), advanced remote ops, theft alert, drive alerts, TomTom navigation, and built-in Amazon Alexa. SiriusXM satellite radio: complimentary 3-month trial, then $9.99-$24.99/mo depending on tier. Free2move Charge promo: 3 years of complimentary 30-minute DC fast-charge sessions on Free2move Charge stations bundled with Launch Edition (Limited gets a lesser credit package). No subscription-locked horsepower, heated seats, ADAS, or driving-mode features as of MY2025. Sources: https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html, https://www.driveuconnect.com/
drmNotes: Core driving, climate, FM/AM radio, CarPlay/Android Auto (wireless), Bluetooth audio, and physical-key locking all function without cellular connectivity. Cloud-tethered features that require an active Stellantis 'Connect ONE' service link: remote lock/unlock via app, EV charging remote start/stop and scheduling via app, vehicle health reports, SOS, stolen-vehicle assist, in-vehicle voice assistant, OTA software updates, and the in-vehicle browser/AppMarket. Connect ONE base tier is included for 10 years from in-service date; what happens after year 10 has not been publicly announced. Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/, https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
killSwitchNotes: No federal-mandate-style impaired-driving kill switch is installed on the 2025 Wagoneer S. The vehicle has a camera-based driver-attention monitor tied to the Active Driving Assist hands-on lane-centering feature (warns if the driver looks away for too long while the system is engaged) and a standard fatigue/drowsy-driver detection that suggests a break — neither immobilizes the vehicle. No in-cabin alcohol sensor. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wagoneer/wagoneer-s/specs.limited.html
knownIssues: Early-build Wagoneer S units (Q4 2024 / Q1 2025) reported Uconnect infotainment freezes, intermittent charging-port firmware faults requiring dealer reset, and a small number of 12V auxiliary battery drain complaints (the BEV's HV battery is fine but the LV battery has surfaced as a weak point). All addressed via OTA TPP updates through 2025. Source: https://www.kbb.com/jeep/wagoneer-s/2025/specs/
recalls: NHTSA 25V-217 (May 2025) — software update for the EV powertrain control module to address a potential loss-of-propulsion condition; OTA remedy. NHTSA 25V-381 (June 2025) — rearview camera image-display software bug; OTA remedy. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Eligibility varies by state. CA CVRP closed Nov 2023 (no current CA rebate). NY Drive Clean rebate up to $2,000 (MSRP cap permitting). NJ Charge Up rebate up to $4,000 for MSRP < $55k (Wagoneer S exceeds the cap). CO state tax credit $5,000 (BEVs < $80k). MA MOR-EV $3,500. Stellantis was extending the $7,500 federal credit as a manufacturer rebate after the federal program ended Sept 2025 for vehicles in inventory. Sources: https://electrek.co/2025/10/03/jeep-dodge-chrysler-vehicles-still-qualify-for-7500-ev-credit/, https://www.jeep.com/4xe/incentives.html

title: Rubicon
adasStandard: Same baseline as Sport S. Rubicon adds locking front and rear differentials, Rock-Trac 4:1 low-range transfer case, electronic sway-bar disconnect, hood vents, rock rails, off-road camera prep. Source: https://www.kbb.com/jeep/wrangler-4xe/2025/rubicon-4xe/
adasOptional: Safety Group (Adaptive Cruise + LDW/LKA + Auto High-Beam) optional. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines.
sideViewCameraNotes: Optional TrailCam (front grille-mounted, off-road forward view). No surround 360 or side-blind camera. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-wrangler-4xe-trims.htm
subscriptionFeatures: Same as Sport S — no subscription gate on locking diffs or sway-bar disconnect.
knownIssues: Same as Sport S — loss-of-propulsion warning history; some owners report battery-fire recall remedy did not fully resolve charging behavior. Source: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/expert-reviews/2025-jeep-wrangler-4xe-review-update
stateIncentives: Same as Sport S — Stellantis $7,500 manufacturer rebate on remaining MY2025 inventory.

title: Rubicon X
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 12.3-inch touchscreen plus premium Alpine audio.
adasStandard: Loaded variant — adds full Safety Group as standard (Adaptive Cruise + LDW/LKA + Auto High-Beam) plus McKinley leather, Body-Color hardtop, premium audio, integrated off-road camera, all Rubicon mechanical content. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-wrangler-4xe-trims.htm
adasOptional: Few options remain; mainly cosmetic. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear camera with dynamic guidelines.
sideViewCameraNotes: Integrated TrailCam (front off-road camera) standard. No surround 360, no side-blind camera. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-wrangler-4xe-trims.htm
stateIncentives: Same as Sport S — Stellantis $7,500 manufacturer rebate on inventory.

title: Sahara
adasStandard: Same as Sport S plus LED taillights, 115V household-style power outlet, Convenience Group content (heated seats/steering wheel, remote start, security alarm). Source: https://www.kbb.com/jeep/wrangler-4xe/2025/sahara-4xe/
adasOptional: Safety Group (Adaptive Cruise + LDW/LKA + Auto High-Beam). Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic guidelines.
sideViewCameraNotes: Optional TrailCam (front-facing). No 360 or side-blind camera. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-wrangler-4xe-trims.htm

title: Sport S
infotainment: Uconnect 5 with 12.3-inch touchscreen (upgraded from 8.4 in prior years).
adasStandard: Forward Collision Warning Plus with AEB (low-rated pedestrian detection per IIHS), Blind-Spot Monitoring + Rear Cross Path Detection, ParkSense rear park assist with stop, ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic guidelines, rain-sensing wipers. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
adasOptional: Optional Safety Group bundles Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop, Lane Departure Warning + Lane Keep Assist (not full lane-centering), Automatic High-Beam control. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic guidelines. Standard-resolution. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
sideViewCameraNotes: No surround-view 360 camera on Sport S; no side-blind/LaneWatch-style camera; no trailer view. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
subscriptionFeatures: Wi-Fi PLUS ~$19.99/mo. SiriusXM 3-month trial then paid. No subscription-locked horsepower, locking diffs, or sway-bar disconnect. Source: https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
drmNotes: Core driving and infotainment (Uconnect 5, CarPlay/Android Auto wireless, Bluetooth, FM/AM) function offline. Remote app, OTA, SOS, EV charging remote control require active Connect ONE (10 years free) cellular link. Sources: https://www.driveuconnect.com/, https://www.jeep.com/uconnect/connectivity.html
killSwitchNotes: No federal-mandate impaired-driving kill switch. Standard drowsy-driver detection issues a chime and warning. No in-cabin alcohol sensor. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
knownIssues: Reports of intermittent loss-of-propulsion warning (subject of NHTSA investigation that led to 2023 stop-sale on prior years), Uconnect bluetooth pairing bugs, battery fire risk on early units (resolved by recall). Some owners report transmission clunks during ICE-to-EV handoff. Sources: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/expert-reviews/2025-jeep-wrangler-4xe-review-update, https://carbuzz.com/jeep-wrangler-iihs-rating-improvement/
recalls: Carryover risk from NHTSA 23V-407 (2023 battery-fire recall for 2021-2024 Wrangler 4xe; remedy software update completed pre-sale on MY2025). 2024-2025 OTAs for charge-port firmware and shift-by-wire calibration. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls
stateIncentives: Lost federal $7,500 Jan 1 2025; Stellantis offering $7,500 manufacturer rebate on remaining inventory. State PHEV rebates apply where offered (CO $5k for BEV/PHEV, NJ Charge Up does not cover 4xe due to MSRP cap, NY Drive Clean $500 PHEV tier eligibility varies). Sources: https://www.carsdirect.com/automotive-news/2025-jeep-plug-in-hybrids-lose-tax-credit, https://www.jeep.com/4xe/incentives.html

title: Willys
adasStandard: Same as Sport S: AEB, Blind-Spot Monitoring + Rear Cross Path, ParkSense rear, ParkView rear camera, rain-sensing wipers. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
adasOptional: Safety Group (Adaptive Cruise + LDW/LKA + Auto High-Beam). Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard ParkView rear backup camera with dynamic guidelines. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
sideViewCameraNotes: No 360-degree camera; no side-blind camera. TrailCam (front-facing off-road camera) is included in the Trails Capability Group on Willys. Source: https://www.tomkelleychryslerdodgejeepram.com/research/jeep-wrangler-4xe-trims.htm
subscriptionFeatures: Same as Sport S — Wi-Fi PLUS ~$19.99/mo; no subscription-gated mechanicals.
drmNotes: Same as Sport S — Uconnect 5 functions offline for core features; remote app, OTA, SOS require Connect ONE link.
killSwitchNotes: Same as Sport S. Source: https://www.jeep.com/wrangler-4xe.html
knownIssues: Same as Sport S — loss-of-propulsion warning history, Uconnect quirks. Source: https://www.jdpower.com/cars/expert-reviews/2025-jeep-wrangler-4xe-review-update
recalls: Same as Sport S — carryover from NHTSA 23V-407 battery-fire recall (remedy applied pre-sale).
stateIncentives: Same as Sport S — Stellantis $7,500 manufacturer rebate on remaining inventory; state PHEV programs vary.
